title: Fix the median function
prompt:
This function should return the median of a list of numbers, but it is wrong for lists with an even number of items, where the median is the mean of the two middle values. It should also raise ValueError for an empty list.

def median(values):
    ordered = sorted(values)
    middle = len(ordered) // 2
    return ordered[middle]

Answer with the corrected Python function only.

title: Fix the chunk function
prompt:
This function should split a list into consecutive chunks of the given size, with a shorter last chunk if needed. It sometimes loses the last item. It should also raise ValueError if size is less than 1.

def chunk(items, size):
    return [items[i:i + size] for i in range(0, len(items) - 1, size)]

Answer with the corrected Python function only.
